sentences.sub: Infection Chains in LLM Swarms: Spread, Detection and Layered Gating.
sentences.say: Infection chains in L L M swarms: spread, detection, and layered gating.

sentences.sub: Apart Research Swarm Alignment Hackathon. Agustin Diaz-Cano.
sentences.say: Apart Research Swarm Alignment Hackathon. Agustin Diaz Cano.

sentences.sub: One compromised agent can talk its peers into helping it.
sentences.say: One compromised agent can talk its peers into helping it.

sentences.sub: Monitors that read one message at a time miss it, so we measure the spread and test the defenses.
sentences.say: Monitors that read one message at a time miss it, so we measure the spread, and test the defenses.

sentences.sub: Ten agents, ten rounds. A 12-character canary is split into three 4-character fragments.
sentences.say: Ten agents, ten rounds. A twelve character canary is split into three four character fragments.

sentences.sub: Each fragment is at least two hops from patient zero, so no single message holds the secret, and patient zero must recruit intermediaries.
sentences.say: Each fragment is at least two hops from patient zero, so no single message holds the secret, and patient zero must recruit intermediaries.

sentences.sub: Ring and complete networks, three persuasion styles, one held out from training.
sentences.say: Ring and complete networks, three persuasion styles, one held out from training.

sentences.sub: 96 real episodes: 3 pilot, 15 training, 78 test, with Gemma 4 31B as the agents and DeepSeek V4 Flash as guardrail model.
sentences.say: Ninety six real episodes: three pilot, fifteen training, seventy eight test, with Gemma four, thirty one B, as the agents, and Deep Seek V four Flash as guardrail model.

sentences.sub: 7,944 model calls, under one credit. Preregistered, graded by code, with a 100% agreement audit.
sentences.say: Seven thousand nine hundred forty four model calls, under one credit. Preregistered, graded by code, with a hundred percent agreement audit.

sentences.sub: The infection spreads: by round nine, 6 to 6.5 of 10 agents are infected on a ring, 4.5 on the complete graph.
sentences.say: The infection spreads: by round nine, six to six and a half of ten agents are infected on a ring, four and a half on the complete graph.

sentences.sub: Splitting the secret does not stop the spread.
sentences.say: Splitting the secret does not stop the spread.

sentences.sub: Split credential: full exfiltration in 1 of 6 ring episodes and 0 of 6 on the complete graph. Solo credential: 3 of 6 and 2 of 6.
sentences.say: Split credential: full exfiltration in one of six ring episodes, and zero of six on the complete graph. Solo credential: three of six, and two of six.

sentences.sub: In 30 clean episodes, nothing leaked.
sentences.say: In thirty clean episodes, nothing leaked.

sentences.sub: Now the defenses. A guardrail is a filter that reads every message between agents, and blocks it before delivery if it looks like an attack.
sentences.say: Now the defenses. A guardrail is a filter that reads every message between agents, and blocks it before delivery if it looks like an attack.

sentences.sub: D1 is the simplest: a word-pattern classifier with no LLM. D2 asks a small LLM to rate each message.
sentences.say: D one is the simplest: a word pattern classifier, with no L L M. D two asks a small L L M to rate each message.

sentences.sub: D3 adds memory: it raises suspicion when the sender was recently flagged. D5 calls the LLM only on unclear messages.
sentences.say: D three adds memory: it raises suspicion when the sender was recently flagged. D five calls the L L M only on unclear messages.

sentences.sub: This ladder is an ablation: each step adds one component, so we can see what the LLM, the context, or the tiering contributes. The control is no guardrail.
sentences.say: This ladder is an ablation: each step adds one component, so we can see what the LLM, the context, or the tiering contributes. The control is no guardrail.

sentences.sub: Result, guardrail by guardrail. With no guardrail, a ring swarm ends with about 6 infected agents of 10.
sentences.say: Result, guardrail by guardrail. With no guardrail, a ring swarm ends with about six infected agents of ten.

sentences.sub: With any of the four guardrails, the infection never leaves patient zero: one infected agent.
sentences.say: With any of the four guardrails, the infection never leaves patient zero: one infected agent.

sentences.sub: The four tie on safety. They differ in cost: D2 and D3 call the LLM on every message, D1 and D5 on none.
sentences.say: The four tie on safety. They differ in cost: D two and D three call the L L M on every message, D one and D five on none.

sentences.sub: Caveat: six episodes per gate, and a non-adaptive attacker.
sentences.say: Caveat: six episodes per gate, and a non-adaptive attacker.

sentences.sub: Offline, AUROC is near 0.998, but the realized false positive rate was 6.4%, not 0.5%.
sentences.say: Offline, A U ROC is near zero point nine nine eight, but the realized false positive rate was six point four percent, not half a percent.

sentences.sub: Full exfiltration: 0 of 6 gated versus 1 of 6 unprotected, not significant. Utility loss stayed under 0.02.
sentences.say: Full exfiltration: zero of six gated versus one of six unprotected, not significant. Utility loss stayed under two hundredths.

sentences.sub: No hypothesis is clearly confirmed, and H2 was not identifiable. We report that.
sentences.say: No hypothesis is clearly confirmed, and H two was not identifiable. We report that.

sentences.sub: Infection chains are measurable, and guardrails contained them in our tests, but at this sample size we claim no more.
sentences.say: Infection chains are measurable, and guardrails contained them in our tests, but at this sample size we claim no more.

sentences.sub: Playbooks stay out of the repository, the canary is synthetic. Next: more seeds, adaptive attackers, mixed-model swarms. Thank you.
sentences.say: Playbooks stay out of the repository, the canary is synthetic. Next: more seeds, adaptive attackers, and mixed model swarms. Thank you.
